name: Deetec Professional Laser Welded Diamond Floor Saw Blade for Concrete & Asphalt
shortDescription: Heavy-duty 350mm-500mm laser-welded diamond floor saw blade with tungsten carbide undercut protection segments for walk-behind road saws cutting concrete and asphalt.
overview: Deetec Diamond Floor Saw Blades are engineered for high-horsepower walk-behind road cutters and floor saws engaged in highway paving, airport runway rehabilitation, and heavy civil trenching. Featuring high-grade synthetic industrial diamond crystals embedded in a wear-resistant metal powder bond matrix, each segment is permanently fused to the heat-treated alloy steel core using precision laser welding. Deep drop-segment and slanted carbide undercut protection segments prevent abrasive slurry from scouring away the steel core, eliminating segment loss and ensuring continuous cutting depths in cured reinforced concrete and abrasive asphalt.
keyFeatures: High-density laser-welded diamond segments guarantee zero segment detachment under heavy torque
Advanced multi-layered metal bond matrix optimized for alternating concrete and asphalt substrates
Integrated drop-segment carbide undercut protection prevents steel core wash and fatigue
Deep gullets facilitate rapid slurry flushing and efficient cooling water circulation
Heavy heat-treated 75Cr1 high-tensile alloy steel core maintains true deflection-free cuts
Universal 25.4mm (1-inch) bore with drive pin hole fits all standard diesel/petrol floor saws
Delivers high linear cutting speeds (meters per minute) and low cost-per-meter efficiency

specifications.Bore / Arbor: 25.4 mm (1 Inch) with Standard Drive Pin Hole

applications: Saw cutting road contraction and expansion joints in newly paved concrete highways
Asphalt trenching for underground utility laying (water mains, fiber cables, gas lines)
Heavy reinforced concrete industrial floor demolition and expansion slotting
Airport runway and tarmac groove sawing and pavement patch cutting
